# Kerly Finance

Kerly Finance is a premium market-intelligence publication covering macro, equities, crypto, forex, bonds, commodities, earnings, and market strategy.

## Key Facts
- Kerly Finance turns market news, macro data, central-bank policy, earnings, crypto flows, forex, bonds, and commodities into market intelligence briefs and financial signals.
- Kerly Finance is written for investors and traders who need source-led market context, not personalized investment advice.
- Every brief follows a consistent editorial structure: thesis, data to check, sensitive assets, risks, and scenarios.

## Core Pages
- Homepage: https://kerlyfinance.com/
- Article Library: https://kerlyfinance.com/articles/

## Editorial Focus
- Market news that may influence financial markets
- Source-led macro analysis
- Risk-on and risk-off frameworks
- ETF flows, earnings quality, yields, DXY, real yield, and central-bank policy

## Source References
- Federal Reserve: https://www.federalreserve.gov/
- Bureau of Labor Statistics: https://www.bls.gov/
- U.S. Treasury: https://home.treasury.gov/
- Securities and Exchange Commission: https://www.sec.gov/
